compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-6: sprint/SKILL.md documents the two-pass flow with a self-contained instruction and an explicit absent-marker fallback.

## TDD Exemption
behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5 (non-executable LLM instruction file): plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md is a prose instruction file; verification is by presence of the documented subsection and required elements. The substantive helper logic is tested by task-1/task-2.

## Implementation
Add a "Two-Pass Migration Ordering" subsection to Phase C (batch-prep, positioned BEFORE the ticket next-batch step) of plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md. Self-contained instruction documenting:
- The helper invocation plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh, run ONCE per story, idempotently.
- The three reserved pair types: automated-sweep/manual-verification, db forward-migration/rollback-verification, feature-flag cutover/flag-cleanup.
- The EXPLICIT absent-marker fallback: no MIGRATION_CLASS marker (or inconclusive) and no feature-flag pair → helper emits NO_MARKER, writes no edges, standard batch ordering applies unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Two-Pass Migration Ordering subsection exists in SKILL.md
  Verify: grep -qi 'Two-Pass Migration Ordering' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- [ ] Subsection references the helper invocation
  Verify: grep -q 'apply-two-pass-ordering.sh' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- [ ] Subsection documents the explicit absent-marker fallback
  Verify: grep -Eqi 'NO_MARKER|absent.?marker|standard.*ordering.*unchanged' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

Verify: grep -qiE 'epic|per-batch|idempotent|descendant' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
